messages.author: f1ce6d55520cb81f
messages.subject: Z values
parts:
Hi All, 

Can anyone help me to work out why the Z values are not shown in the output when I ran a sem (lavaan) model. 
My data is 132 observations and 37 variables. 

Some of the variables have 0s. 

Thanks, 
Fayoz

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: Z values
parts:
Maybe this is scaling problem? Can you rescale your observed variables
so that they all have more or less the same scale, and try again?

The varTable() function will show you the observed variances of all
model variables.

Yves.
